svg.title: Pairwise distance implementations, from Python loops to AVX-512
svg.desc: Horizontal log-scale bars from 42 ns for Python loops down to 0.05 ns for reordered C loops with AVX-512; NumPy broadcasting is slower than a NumPy row loop; the GEMM reformulation is the fastest NumPy rung.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One problem, eight rungs: pairwise squared distances, 1024 × 1024 points, d = 64

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ns per (pair × dimension), log scale, shorter is faster · Xeon (Emerald Rapids), 1 core, gcc 13.3, NumPy 2.5 (single core)
